description:
Hallyu star vampire Ji Eun-pa and his fan Jo Eun-jo met each other as junior and junior college students. Eun-pa has a thirst that has not been quenched even by the blood of a vampire bride, but It begins to be relieved by Jo Eun-jo's blood. Can they fix their mixed destiny as a "real" vampire bride?  
It is a contemporary fantasy-vampire romance story, seeking true love beyond the curse of the family.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5230886), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1020005434), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55250472), [MComics](https://www.mcomics.co.kr/webtoonComic/7489), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/biteme_rk), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/bite_me), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=240063), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=mdg0), [Qtoon](https://www.qtoon.co.kr/toon/list.mg?tcode=0y4b)
